intro.h2: Tile and flooring installation in Baton Rouge, LA, from one owner
paragraphs: Parish Flooring is a flooring contractor in Baton Rouge, LA, owned by Micah Simon. We focus on four things: tile work, tile showers, flooring and vinyl plank. Our motto is simple: quality work, honest service, reliable results.

Our most recent project shows the range. We installed a glossy white subway tile backsplash in one kitchen and rebuilt a living room fireplace with brick-look tile on the surround and a herringbone hearth set flush into a wide plank floor. Whether you are redoing one shower or flooring a whole house, call Micah directly to talk through the layout, the materials and the timing.

items.name: Tile showers
items.blurb: Showers are one of the four services printed on our business card. We tile shower walls, floors and niches, and we can help you choose tile that suits the room. Call Micah to talk about replacing a dated tub surround or building a walk-in shower from the floor up.

items.name: Kitchen backsplashes
items.blurb: Our latest Google post shows a recently completed kitchen backsplash. The kitchen here has glossy white subway tile running behind the cooktop and up to the cabinets, with a pot filler set into the wall. Clean cuts around outlets and cabinet ends are what make a backsplash look finished.

image.alt: Glossy white subway tile backsplash behind a cooktop with a pot filler, between white raised-panel cabinets

items.name: Flooring and vinyl plank
items.blurb: Flooring is in our name. We install vinyl plank and other flooring through living areas, kitchens and bedrooms, laid so the planks run straight from room to room. Tell us the rooms and the look you want, and we will help you plan transitions and layout.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a newly installed warm brown vinyl plank floor running through an open living and dining area of a South Louisiana home, white baseboards, light walls, a tall window with soft daylight, a few simple furnishings, planks running in straight even lines, deep green and cream accents, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:3

items.name: Fireplace tile and brick
items.blurb: Tile work does not stop at bathrooms and kitchens. For a recent living room fireplace renovation we set brick-look tile around the firebox and laid a herringbone hearth that sits flush with the wide plank floor. Ask us about refreshing a dated fireplace surround.

image.alt: Fireplace with brick-look tile surround, white mantel column and a herringbone brick hearth meeting a wide plank floor

items.title: You deal with the owner
items.text: Micah Simon owns Parish Flooring, and you can call him directly at (225) 718-3166 to talk through your tile or flooring plans.

items.title: Focused on tile and floors
items.text: We do not try to be everything. Tile work, showers, flooring and vinyl plank are the four things we do, and we put our time into doing them well.

items.title: Details at the edges
items.text: Look at the fireplace in our photos: the herringbone hearth meets the wide plank floor in a clean line, and the brick-look tile wraps the firebox evenly.

items.title: Six days a week
items.text: We are open Monday through Saturday from 8 AM to 4 PM, so you can reach us on a Saturday if weekdays are busy for you.

about.text: Parish Flooring is a Baton Rouge flooring contractor owned by Micah Simon. Our logo, a pelican standing on a tile pattern and framed by magnolia blossoms, is about as Louisiana as it gets. We keep the business focused on tile work, showers, flooring and vinyl plank, and when you call, you talk with Micah himself. Our motto sums up how we work: quality work, honest service, reliable results. Call us any weekday or Saturday from 8 AM to 4 PM.

process.h2: How a tile or flooring job goes

steps.title: Call Micah
steps.text: Call (225) 718-3166, Monday to Saturday from 8 AM to 4 PM, and describe the room and the tile or flooring you have in mind.

steps.title: Measure and plan
steps.text: We measure the space and talk through layout, transitions and materials with you before anything is ordered.

steps.title: Prep and install
steps.text: Old flooring or tile comes out, the surface is prepped, and the new tile or plank goes down in straight, even lines.

steps.title: Clean up and walk through
steps.text: We clean up and walk the finished room with you so you can check every edge and transition.

service_area.h2: Tile and flooring installation in Baton Rouge, LA
service_area.text: Parish Flooring works in Baton Rouge, LA. If your home is outside the city and you are wondering whether we can take your project, call (225) 718-3166 and tell us where you are. We are open Monday through Saturday from 8 AM to 4 PM. Let us know whether you need a shower, a backsplash or new floors, and roughly how many rooms are involved.

items.a: We focus on tile work, tile showers, flooring and vinyl plank. Our recent projects include a kitchen backsplash in glossy white subway tile and a living room fireplace with a brick-look tile surround and a herringbone hearth. If your job involves tile or floors, give us a call.

items.q: Do you install vinyl plank flooring?
items.a: Yes. Vinyl plank is one of the four services we list on our business card. It is a popular choice for living areas, kitchens and bedrooms. Tell us the rooms and the look you like, and we will help you plan the layout and the transitions between rooms.

Yes, showers are one of our main services. We tile shower walls, floors and niches. Call Micah at (225) 718-3166 to describe your current shower and what you would like instead, and send a photo or two if you can.

items.q: Who do I talk to about my project?
items.a: You talk with Micah Simon, who owns Parish Flooring. Call (225) 718-3166 to describe the job, ask questions about tile or flooring choices and set up a time to measure the space. Dealing with the owner keeps communication simple from start to finish.

We are open Monday through Saturday from 8 AM to 4 PM and closed on Sunday. Call (225) 718-3166, email parishflooringllc@gmail.com or message us on Facebook to ask about your tile or flooring project. Photos of the room and rough measurements help us give you a useful answer.

final_cta.h2: Ready for new tile or floors?
final_cta.text: Call Micah to talk about your shower, backsplash or flooring project in Baton Rouge.
